dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Look at the time! What am I going to do now... They'll be here any minute...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, Nicole, we're heeeere! Hey, why are you pushing us out?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Oh dear, oh dear... I'm sorry about this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't you ready yet?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: How should I put this... Oh, blast, I'm afraid I can't explain it very clearly. I'll have to tell you the whole story...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: It all started the first time the mages challenged the Anemo Archon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nicole, that's... way too long ago!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Ugh, this isn't fair! It's so embarrassing that you'd end up having to hear this from my own mouth... No! It can't be helped, the facts are the facts... Just so long as Alice doesn't hear about this, there's no reason for anyone to laugh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh dear, her inner monologue's leaking out again... Besides, it's not really coming from her own "mouth"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shh...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: I decided to hide the feathers at the top of the study. I figured if I made things harder, there'd be a greater sense of accomplishment...

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: But I'm really not very good at controlling these carefree eddies. I can only fly so high before I seem to hit an invisible ceiling.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can't you use magic to bring the feathers back down?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Where would be the fun in that!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon sees your point... Hmm, that sure is a tricky one...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nicole, could you try saying something?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: What do you want me to say?

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Oh! I get what you're saying! Alright, I'll give it a try!

response.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
response.text: Ugh, this isn't fair! It's so embarrassing that you'd end up having to hear this from my own mouth...

response.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
response.text: No! It can't be helped, the facts are the facts...

response.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
response.text: Just so long as Alice doesn't hear about this, there's no reason for anyone to laugh...

choices.text: Maybe you could say something that will become a staircase...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nicole, this is a dead end!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, it really worked! Say something else!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Leave it to me! Leave it to me! Leave it to me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh... You're just repeating yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, that gap's so big!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: All things may serve as guides... The scriptures filled... with names divine! The words and chapters... intertwine... and angels act with deeds aligned! In this sacred place, let words forge the path ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: See? All taken care of.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: All things may serve as guides... The scriptures filled... with names divine!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: The words and chapters... intertwine... and angels act with deeds aligned!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: In this sacred place, let words forge the path ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Treasure! Woohoo, this is so much fun!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... Paimon's head really is pounding. Seriously, did Nicole actually need to shout that loud just to make those stairs appear...?

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: What's this? Complaining now, are we? Aren't you worried a powerful mage like me might snap her fingers and turn those new trinkets into turnips?

choices.text: P—Paimon didn't mean anything by it...

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Hehe, I'm only joking with you. You should know I'm not the silent, sulking sort of angel that keeps track of every little slight.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: #...And so, when their day of reckoning finally arrived, {NICKNAME} and Paimon ascended the seven-tiered steps to find a familiar figure awaiting them.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: Radiant flames converged to form wings upon her back. Her figure remained as noble and beautiful as the day they first met, yet her eyes now shone with a cruel light.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: #"But why?" asked {NICKNAME} and Paimon in unison.

response.speaker: Nicole
response.text: "It all started the day Paimon complained that I shouted too loudly!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Words are magic here, don't you know! Don't say such scary things!

choices.text: Come on, don't take it to heart...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This must be the final door, right? Let's hurry up and find Nicole!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Watch your step!

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: Watch your step!
